# Happy Hearts on the Hudson

> A comprehensive childcare center in Croton-On-Hudson, NY offering infant through school-age programs with curriculum-based early childhood education aligned to NYS Learning Standards.

Happy Hearts on the Hudson provides full-spectrum childcare services in Westchester County, including infant care, toddler programs, preschool, Pre-K, and before/after school care. The center emphasizes child development, early education, and family engagement through enrollment, blog resources, and parent testimonials.
